༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (pha)pa'i dkar chag/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (pha)pa'i dkar chag /

ka bka' brgyud rin po che gser gyi phreng ba la bstod pa gsol 'debs dang bcas pa/ kha shog dril bzhi'i brgyud rim gsol 'debs/ ga lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i lo rgyus bsdus pa/ nga lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ smin lam dbang gi chu bo/ ca yang zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ phyi sgrub byin rlabs 'byung gnas/ cha lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ nang sgrub 'khor 'das rang grol/ ja lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ gsang sgrub ye shes rgya mtsho/ nya lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ de kho na nyid du sgrub pa spros bral mthar phyin/ ta lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las// rtsa rlung rdo rje'i phreng ba/ tha lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ rdzogs rim mnyam yangs mtha' bral/ da bla sgrub gnad kyi zhal shes shin tu gsang ba/ na lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ gegs sel bde ba'i rdo rje/ pa lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ kha bsgyur gzhan phan snying po/ pha lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ kha bsgyur gzhan phan snying po'i 'phro/ ba rdo'i bcud len rin chen mchog gi gsang ba'i gter mdzod/ ma lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i kha skong las byang yid bzhin nor bu/ tsa lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ rgyun 'khyer rgyas pa/ tsha lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ rgyun 'khyer shin tu bsdus pa/ dza bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyung ngur gdams pa rnams/ wa thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi rol mtsho/ zha zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsdus pa/ za rtog med don dam rdo rje'i glu zhes bya ba nges don phyag rgya chen po/ 'a phyag rgya chen po'i zhal gdams kyi skor rnams/ ya rten rdzas dang snyan dar phul ba'i smon tshig dang 'dod gsol bcas/ ra bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs brtan/ la brtan bzhugs kyi rim pa rnams/ sha gsol 'debs smon lam gyi rim pa dad pa'i chu skyes bzhad pa/ sa smon lam gyi rim pa tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho/ ha yon bshad legs par phye ba'i gtam kun tu dga' ba'i phreng ba/ a gser 'od dam pa'i mdo'i le'u las bshags pa'i smon lam mdor bsdus bris pa/
ki gshin po'i bsngo ba zur bkol rgyas par phye ba rgyu 'bras theg pa'i lam rim yongs su tshang ba/
